 Print PGIMER Nursing Officer admit card 2026 released for 243 vacancies, check CBT exam date and download details PGIMER Nursing Officer admit card 2026 : The Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh, has released the admit card for the Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026 examination. Candidates who applied for the 243 Group B vacancies can now download their hall tickets through the institute's official website, pgimer.edu.in. The admit cards were made available on November 5, 2026. The Computer Based Test (CBT), which was initially scheduled for October 21, has been postponed to November 18, 2026. The recruitment is being conducted under Advertisement No. PGI/RC/055/2026/2276 for direct appointments at PGIMER Chandigarh. PGIMER Nursing Officer recruitment 2026 overview The recruitment offers 243 Nursing Officer vacancies under the Level-7 pay scale. The selected candidates will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400. Particulars

 Important dates and application fees The recruitment notification was issued on September 9, 2026. Online applications opened on September 10 and closed on October 3, 2026. The last date to download the submitted application form was October 6, 2026. The application fee was Rs. 1,500 for UR, OBC and EWS candidates, and Rs. 800 for SC and ST candidates. Persons with Disabilities (PWD) candidates were exempted from payment. Fees were accepted online. How to download the PGIMER admit card
 Step 1: Visit the official website, pgimer.edu.in. Step 2: Open the recruitment or examination section. Step 3: Find the Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026 admit card link. Step 4: Enter the required login credentials. Step 5: Submit the details and download the admit card. Step 6: Check the examination details and take a printout. Candidates should check their admit card for examination centre details, reporting instructions and other particulars before appearing for the CBT. • Direct link to check and download the PGIMER admit card Eligibility criteria and educational qualifications Applicants must be between 18 and 35 years of age, calculated as of October 3, 2026. Age relaxation will apply according to the prescribed rules. Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Hons) Nursing, B.Sc. Nursing or Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing qualification with State Nursing Council registration. Alternatively, applicants with a GNM diploma must have State Nursing Council registration and at least one year of experience in a hospital with a minimum of 50 beds. CBT exam pattern and selection process The examination will be conducted in English and comprise 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks. Candidates will receive 100 minutes to complete the test. Each incorrect answer will attract a negative marking of 0.25 marks. The qualifying marks are 40% for General and EWS candidates and 35% for SC, ST and OBC candidates. Selection will involve the CBT, scrutiny of applications and documents, document verification, PET/PMT and medical fitness assessment. Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination by the Institute's Medical Board before appointment.
